thumb|right
thumb|right
All-Star Archer Bow is a level 12 Archer weapon. It is no longer able to be acquired. It was previously acquired by completion of the quest Archer: Cutting Out the Buyers.

Cannot Trade.

 Required 

Level 12, Archer

 Effects 

Barrage: Launches several arrows at once, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2609 damage.

Volley: Rains arrows down around you striking nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 4732 damage.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
All-Star Brawler Hammer is a level 12 Brawler weapon. It is no longer able to be acquired. It was previously acquired by completion of the quest Brawler: Confronting the Crook.

Cannot trade.

 Required 

Level 12, Brawler

 Effects 

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2372 damage.
Sometimes knocks opponents down.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all enemies around you.
Deals 8302 damage.
Knocks opponents down.

Cannot Trade.

wiki_page.title: Apartment
wiki_page.text:
thumb|256px|View of the entrance.Apartment on ZAM
thumb|256px|View from the doorway.
The Apartment is a housing lot that was formerly awarded to every new player.Free Realms: The Official Handbook and Strategy Guide on Internet Archive On January 26, 2012, the Wilds Condo replaced the Apartment as the starting home for new players. Players who already had an Apartment before this date kept their Apartment and received a new Wilds Condo.

Description
This plot contains only a small apartment with 1 room. Default, the walls are a dark blue and the floor is made out of wood. It contains a fireplace and 5 windows. It is possible to go out of bounds by passing through the roof. free realms how to get out of your house (laketree lot, condo, and apartment) on YouTube

Dimensions
The dimensionsFree Realms Detailed Housing Guide on GuideScroll of the apartment are:
Height: 4 Blocks
Width 9.5 Blocks
Length 10.5 Blocks
Volume 399 Blocks

wiki_page.title: Anguish Aid Bonesaw
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Anguish Aid Bonesaw is a level 8 Medic weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Anguish Aid Bonesaw.

 Required 

Level 8, Medic

 Effects 

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 1492 damage.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby enemies.
Heals 1357 damage.
Deals 4750 damage.
Category:Medic
Category:Level 8 Weapons

Category:Blacksmith Recipe Weapons
Category:Green Text Weapons
Category:Particle Effect
Category:Triage
Category:Weapon

 Required 

Level 16, Archer

 Effects 

Electric Arrow: Shoots several electric arrows, damaging any enemies in front of you.
Deals 2372 damage.
Chance to deal extra damage.

Lightning Call: Shoots a magic arrow into the air that calls lightning to damage all enemies around you.
Deals 8302 damage.

wiki_page.title: Arrow Tempered Circle Shard
wiki_page.text:
thumb
This circle shard gives you a slight experience boost as an archer.

Arrow Tempered Circle Shard is a level 1 Archer flair shard. It is acquired from the Daily Wheel, from the Shards wedge.

While equipped, the Arrow Tempered Circle Shard provides an increase in stars earned from battles. However, it has no visual effect on the user's weapon.free realms before sunset

Cannot Trade.

 Required 
Level 1, Archer.

 Effects 
+1 Star Boost.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
A magical orb that knocks enemies away from you.

Blast Sphere is a level 1 battle item usable in any job. It is acquired from the Coin Shop where it sells for 50 coins and it is acquired from Battle Item Mystery Packs.

 Required 

Level 1, Any Job

 Activatable Effects 

Knocks back all targets caught in the blast.

wiki_page.title: Biting Mongoose Blade
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Biting Mongoose Blade is a level 4 Ninja weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Biting Mongoose Blade.

 Required 

Level 4, Ninja

 Effects 

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 444 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 1998 damage.

thumb
thumb|Virtual Reward card.

A powerful ring that greatly increases your talent as a chef when equipped.

Brambleback Broiler Ring is level 1 Chef jewelry. It is acquired through redeeming the Trading Card Game Series 2 Virtual Reward loot card of the same name. The card's ID is 2L5.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required
Level 1, Chef

Passive Effects
+117 Talent.

wiki_page.title: Briarheart Bandage Square Shard
wiki_page.text:
alt=|thumb
thumb|Virtual Reward card.

A powerful shard that increases a Medic's health.

Briarheart Bandage Square Shard is a level 1 Medic power shard with effects identical to Medic's Power Shard of Vitality V. It is acquired through redeeming the Trading Card Game Series 2 Virtual Reward loot card of the same name. The card's ID is 2L6.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required
Level 1, Medic

Passive Effects
Increases health by 712 in combat.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Briarsting Bow is a level 1 Archer weapon. It is acquired by redeeming Shattered Past! virtual reward card 2L7 Briarsting Bow. The particle effect seen on Briarsting Bow is duplicated by the flair shard Archer's Flair Shard of Thorns.

Cannot Trade.

 Required 

Level 1, Archer

 Effects 

Barrage: Launches several arrows at once, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 3391 damage.

Volley: Rains arrows down around you striking nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 6143 damage.

wiki_page.title: Brutal Blast Bow
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Brutal Blast Bow is a level 16 Archer weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Brutal Blast Bow.

 Required 

Level 16, Archer

 Effects 

Barrage: Launches several arrows at once, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2609 damage.

Volley: Rains arrows down around you striking nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 4732 damage.

wiki_page.title: Bubbleburst Blade
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Bubbleburst Blade is a level 4 Ninja weapon. It is a Blue Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 4, Ninja

 Effects 

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 776 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 3492 damage.

wiki_page.title: Chivalrous Guardian Hammer
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Chivalrous Guardian Hammer is a level 8 Warrior weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Chivalrous Guardian Hammer.

 Required 

Level 8, Warrior

 Effects 

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby enemies.
Deals 1492 damage.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 2707 damage.

wiki_page.text:
thumb
This circle shard gives you a slight experience boost as a warrior.

Champion Tempered Circle Shard is a level 1 Warrior flair shard. It is acquired from the Daily Wheel, from the Shards wedge.

While equipped, the Champion Tempered Circle Shard provides an increase in stars earned from battles. However, it has no visual effect on the user's weapon.free realms lvl 20 warrior with special axe

Cannot Trade.

 Required 
Level 1, Warrior.

Effects
+1 Star Boost.

wiki_page.title: Diving Hawk Scythe
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Diving Hawk Scythe is a level 8 Ninja weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Diving Hawk Scythe.

 Required 

Level 8, Ninja

 Effects 

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 1357 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 6107 damage.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Courageous Defender Axe is a level 4 Warrior weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 4, Warrior

 Effects 

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby enemies.
Deals 853 damage.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 1548 damage.

wiki_page.title: Dragon Blade
wiki_page.text:
Dragon Blade is the name of two different Ninja weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Dragon Blade
thumb|right|New School Dragon Blade
thumb|right|New School Dragon Blade

The New School version of Dragon Blade is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

wiki_page.title: EKG Crutch
wiki_page.text:
EKG Crutch is the name of two different Medic weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School EKG Crutch
thumb|right|New School EKG Crutch
thumb|right|New School EKG Crutch

The New School version of EKG Crutch is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Medic

Effects

Bonk: Bonk all opponents in front of you with your electrified crutch.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Flail: A series of high power swings that will damage opponents in front of you over the next few seconds.
Deals 4x 377 damage at Level 1.
Deals 4x 659 damage at Level 4.
Deals 4x 1152 damage at Level 8.
Deals 4x 2015 damage at Level 12.
Deals 4x 3522 damage at Level 16.

Old School EKG Crutch
thumb|right|Old School EKG Crutch
thumb|right|Old School EKG Crutch

The Old School version of EKG Crutch was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Medic

Effects

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3391 damage.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby opponents.
Heals 3083 damage.
Deals 10792 damage.

Elemental Procedure is the name of three different Medic weapons. One is a level 1 New School weapon sold through the SC shop, the other is a level 1 Old School weapon previously sold through the SC Shop, and another is a level 16 Treasure Trader weapon.

Elemental Procedure has four different particle effects, which alternate in sequence every few seconds.

New School Elemental Procedure
thumb|right|New School Elemental Procedure
thumb|right|New School Elemental Procedure

The New School version of Elemental Procedure is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Medic

Effects

Elemental Slice: Slice at all opponents in front of you.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Elemental Overload: Unleash an elemental overload damaging all nearby opponents.
Deals 889 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1554 damage at Level 4.
Deals 2716 damage at Level 8.
Deals 4750 damage at Level 12.
Deals 8320 damage at Level 16.

Old School Elemental Procedure
thumb|right|Old School Elemental Procedure
thumb|right|Old School Elemental Procedure

The Old School version of Elemental Procedure was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Medic

Effects

Clear!: Sends out a stunning electrical current. Damages all nearby opponents.
Deals 2372 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Shock Paddles: Emits a powerful shockwave, damaging all nearby opponents.
Deals 8302 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

wiki_page.title: Fast Blast Bow
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Fast Blast Bow is a level 4 Archer weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 4, Archer

 Effects 

Barrage: Launches several arrows at once, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 488 damage.

Volley: Rains arrows down around you striking nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 885 damage.
Category:Archer
Category:Level 4 Weapons
Category:Power 2 Weapons
Category:Retired Weapons
Category:Green Text Weapons
Category:Particle Effect
Category:Volley
Category:Weapon

 Required 

Level 16, Ninja

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2372 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 10674 damage.

thumb|right
thumb|right
First Aid Hammer is a level 1 Medic weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 1, Medic

 Effects 

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 279 damage.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby enemies.
Heals 254 damage.
Deals 889 damage.

Deals 4732 damage.

wiki_page.title: Exploding Axe
wiki_page.text:
Exploding Axe is the name of two different Warrior weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Exploding Axe
thumb|right|New School Exploding Axe
thumb|right|New School Exploding Axe

The New School version of Exploding Axe is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Warrior

Effects

Twilight Strike: Attack all opponents in front of you with the power of twilight. Has a slightly longer reach.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Vampiric Wrath: Damages all nearby opponents and drains some of their health.
Instantly heals you for 11% health.
Deals 889 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1554 damage at Level 4.
Deals 2716 damage at Level 8.
Deals 4750 damage at Level 12.

Old School Exploding Axe
thumb|right|Old School Exploding Axe
thumb|right|Old School Exploding Axe

The Old School version of Exploding Axe was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Warrior

Effects

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby opponents.
Deals 3391 damage.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby opponents multiple times.
Deals 6143 damage.

wiki_page.title: Flowing Emerald Blade
wiki_page.text:
Flowing Emerald Blade is the name of two different Ninja weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Flowing Emerald Blade
thumb|right|New School Flowing Emerald Blade
thumb|right|New School Flowing Emerald Blade

The New School version of Flowing Emerald Blade is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Emerald Slash: Perform a dazzling slash damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Noxious Cloud: A billowing poison cloud that damages all nearby opponents.
Deals 3x 506 damage at Level 1.
Deals 3x 885 damage at Level 4.
Deals 3x 1548 damage at Level 8.
Deals 3x 2707 damage at Level 12.
Deals 3x 4732 damage at Level 16.

Old School Flowing Emerald Blade
thumb|right|Old School Flowing Emerald Blade
thumb|right|Old School Flowing Emerald Blade

The Old School version of Flowing Emerald Blade was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3083 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 13876 damage.

cforest-branch-97701.title: Forest Branch
client_cluster: locale:97701 [item | - | Forest Branch] 'Forest Branch'

wiki_page.title: Forest Branch
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Forest Branch is a level 1 Archer weapon. It is a Blue Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade. The particle effect seen on Forest Branch is also seen on Nature's Branch and is duplicated by the flair shard Archer's Flair Shard of Autumn.

 Required 

Level 1, Archer

 Effects 

Barrage: Launches several arrows at once, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 488 damage.

Volley: Rains arrows down around you striking nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 885 damage.

wiki_page.title: Frenzy Fighter Hammer
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Frenzy Fighter Hammer is a level 16 Brawler weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Frenzy Fighter Hammer.

 Required 

Level 16, Brawler

 Effects 

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2372 damage.
Sometimes knocks opponents down.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all enemies around you.
Deals 8302 damage.
Knocks opponents down.

wiki_page.text:
thumb
The Gold Pinwheel Firework is a consumable firework.

New Years Packs
New Years 2014 Party Pack
Two Gold Pinwheel Fireworks were included as a part of the New Years 2014 Party Packmarketplace bundle; Members that logged-in between December 31, 2013 and January 1, 2014 received a complimentary New Years 2014 Party Pack.

New Years 2014 Fireworks Pack
Four Gold Pinwheel Fireworks were included as a part of the New Years 2014 Fireworks Pack marketplace bundle.

Heroic Champion Axe is a level 16 Warrior weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

Level 16, Warrior

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby enemies.
Deals 2609 damage.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 4732 damage.

wiki_page.title: Grave Elemental
wiki_page.text:
Were you look for the pet pal?

The Grave Elemental is an enemy NPC that appears throughout Blackspore Swamp.

Battle
Grave Elementals can be found wandering in Blackspore Swamp. They are featured in the Bone Bog Cemetery. They also feature at Super Spooktacular when the Pumpkin Prince arrives. Sometimes the Pumpkin Prince will spawn a spawner which will spawn hostiles such as Grave Elementals and Necrowart Zombies.

Appearances
Haunted by the Past
Bone Bog Cemetery
Trading Card Game Series 4

wiki_page.title: Golden Hammer
wiki_page.text:
Golden Hammer is the name of two different Brawler weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Golden Hammer
thumb|right|New School Golden Hammer
thumb|right|New School Golden Hammer

The New School version of Golden Hammer is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Brawler

Effects

Brilliant Smash: Smash opponents in front of you as they stare in awe at the brilliance of your hammer.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Supernova: Damages all nearby opponents with the power of the sun.
Deals 889 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1554 damage at Level 4.
Deals 2716 damage at Level 8.
Deals 4750 damage at Level 12.
Deals 8302 damage at Level 16.

Old School Golden Hammer
thumb|right|Old School Golden Hammer
thumb|right|Old School Golden Hammer

The Old School version of Golden Hammer was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Brawler

Effects

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3083 damage.
Sometimes knocks opponents down.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all opponents around you.
Deals 10792 damage.
Knocks opponents down.

thumb|right
Grief Relief Hammer is a level 1 Medic weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 1, Medic

 Effects 

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 488 damage.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby enemies.
Heals 444 damage.
Deals 1554 damage.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Jeweled Kendama Hammer is a level 5 Brawler weapon. It is a Blue Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 5, Brawler

 Effects 

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 776 damage.
Sometimes knocks opponents down.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all enemies around you.
Deals 2716 damage.
Knocks opponent down

Ignis is the name of two different Ninja weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Ignis
thumb|right|New School Ignis
thumb|right|New School Ignis

The New School version of Ignis is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Tiger Claw: An ancient ninja technique used to damage all opponents in front of you.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Heat Wave: A searing wave of fire damages opponents in front of you.
Deals 1143 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1998 damage at Level 4.
Deals 3492 damage at Level 8.
Deals 6107 damage at Level 12.
Deals 10674 damage at Level 16.

Old School Ignis
thumb|right|Old School Ignis
thumb|right|Old School Ignis

The Old School version of Ignis was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3083 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 13876 damage.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Illuminating Hammer is a level 12 Warrior weapon. It is a Blue Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade. The particle effect seen on Illuminating Hammer is duplicated by the flair shard Warrior's Keen Flair Shard.

 Required 

Level 12, Warrior

 Effects 

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby enemies.
Deals 2609 damage.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 4732 damage.

wiki_page.title: Jeweled Wand
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Jeweled Wand is a level 5 Wizard weapon. It is a Blue Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 5, Wizard

 Effects 

Zap: Zaps enemies with lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 488 damage.

Lightning Blast: Creates a huge blast of lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 1998 damage.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Medic's Megasaw of Shock is a level 12 Medic weapon. It is acquired from the Coin Shop where it sells for  and it is also acquired from the prize wheels at Grexan's Camp and Shady Smugglers!.

 Required 

Level 12, Medic

 Effects 

Clear!: Sends out a stunning electrical current. Damages all nearby opponents.
Deals 1357 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Shock Paddles: Emits a powerful shockwave, damaging all nearby opponents.
Deals 4750 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

wiki_page.title: Molten Bow
wiki_page.text:
Molten Bow is the name of three different Archer weapons. One is a level 1 New School weapon sold through the SC shop, the other is a level 1 Old School weapon previously sold through the SC Shop, and another is a level 16 Treasure Trader weapon.

New School Molten Bow
thumb|right|New School Molten Bow
thumb|right|New School Molten Bow

The New School version of Molten Bow is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Archer

Effects

Magma Shot: A fiery shot that burns with the heat of molten magma.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Volcanic Rain: A volley of burning arrows that rain down upon all nearby opponents.
Deals 3x 506 damage at Level 1.
Deals 3x 885 damage at Level 4.
Deals 3x 1548 damage at Level 8.
Deals 3x 2707 damage at Level 12.
Deals 3x 4732 damage at Level 16.

Old School Molten Bow
thumb|right|Old School Molten Bow
thumb|right|Old School Molten Bow

The Old School version of Molten Bow was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Archer

Effects

Barrage: Launches several arrows at once, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3391 damage.

Volley: Rains arrows down around you striking nearby opponents multiple times.
Deals 6143 damage.

Treasure Trader Molten Bow
thumb|right|Treasure Trader Molten Bow
thumb|right|Treasure Trader Molten Bow

The Treasure Trader version of Molten Bow was previously acquired from the Facebook application, Free Realms Treasure Trader. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell.

wiki_page.title: Molten Precursor Hover Boots
wiki_page.text:
thumb
thumb

The Molten Precursor Hover Boots are a Freestyle Jobs Feet slot clothing item that are acquired through opening Series 1 Mystery Chests or through trade. Hover Boots allow the player to appear as if they are flying.

Cannot sell.

Category:Feet
Category:Freestyle Jobs

thumb 
Luminous Axe is a level 16 Warrior weapon. It is a Blue Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 16, Warrior

 Effects 

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby enemies.
Deals 2609 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 4732 damage.

wiki_page.title: Medium Health Potion
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
A potion that restores some of your health over 3 seconds.

Medium Health Potion is a level 1 potion usable in any job. It is acquired from the Coin Shop where it sells for 25 coins and it is acquired from Battle Item Mystery Packs.

 Required 

Level 1, Any Job

 Activatable Effects 

Heals you for 16% health/second for 3 seconds.
Instantly heals you for 2% health.

Category:Potions

wiki_page.title: Milk Carton
wiki_page.text:
thumb
The Milk Carton is a Freestyle Jobs Hands slot clothing item that currently can only be acquired through trade. The Milk Carton had been originally acquired through completion of a now unavailable Quest named Milk Rocks. The quest featured an NPC found south of Snowhill named Perry who requests assistance collecting rocks for a rock collection contest. The grand prize of the contest had been a milk carton signed by The Dares.

The Milk Carton causes the player equipped to appear having a milk mustache.

thumb|right
thumb|right
Nature's Bark is a level 1 Medic weapon. It is a Blue Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 1, Medic

 Effects 

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 488 damage.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby enemies.
Heals 444 damage.
Deals 1554 damage.

Nature's Branch is a level 1 Archer weapon. It is a Blue Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade. The particle effect seen on Nature's Branch is also seen on Forest Branch and is duplicated by the flair shard Archer's Flair Shard of Autumn.

 Required 

Level 1, Archer

 Effects 

Barrage: Launches several arrows at once, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 488 damage.

Volley: Rains arrows down around you striking nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 885 damage.

wiki_page.text:

Nether Enchanted Wand is a level 16 Wizard weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 16, Wizard

 Effects 

Zap: Zaps enemies with lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2609 damage.

Lightning Blast: Creates a huge blast of lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 10674 damage.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Ninja's Shadow Blade of Shuriken Storm is a level 16 Ninja weapon. It is acquired from the Coin Shop where it sells for  and it is also acquired from the prize wheel at Haunted Mines.

 Required 

Level 16, Ninja

 Effects 

Twisted Edge: Sword technique that damages all nearby opponents.
Deals 2870 damage.

Shuriken Storm: Launches throwing stars in every direction, damaging all nearby opponents.
Deals 8302 damage.

wiki_page.title: Orbital Wand
wiki_page.text:
Orbital Wand is the name of two different Wizard weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Orbital Wand
thumb|right|New School Orbital Wand
thumb|right|New School Orbital Wand

The New School version of Orbital Wand is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Wizard

Effects

Starshower: Launch shooting stars at all nearby opponents.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Orbital Strike: Unleash the fury of the cosmos on all nearby opponents.
Deals 889 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1554 damage at Level 4.
Deals 2716 damage at Level 8.
Deals 4750 damage at Level 12.
Deals 8302 damage at Level 16.

Old School Orbital Wand
thumb|right|Old School Orbital Wand
thumb|right|Old School Orbital Wand

The Old School version of Orbital Wand was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Wizard

Effects

Zap: Zaps enemies with lightning, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3391 damage. 

Lightning Blast: Creates a huge blast of lightning, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 13876 damage.

wiki_page.title: Pro Warrior Hammer
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right

Pro Warrior Hammer is a level 8 Warrior weapon. It is no longer able to be acquired. It was previously acquired by completion of the quest Warrior: Knocking Some Sense In.

Cannot Trade.

 Required 

Level 8, Warrior

 Effects 

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby enemies.
Deals 853 damage.

Spinning Attack: Spins around you with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 1548 damage.

Category:Warrior
Category:Level 8 Weapons
Category:Power 3 Weapons
Category:Retired Weapons
Category:Unobtainable Weapons
Category:Spinning Attack
Category:Weapon
Category:Combat Weapon

wiki_page.title: Pixie Dust Flair Shard
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
You'll be thinking happy thoughts with this flair shard equipped.

Pixie Dust Flair Shard is a level 1 flair shard usable in any job. It was formerly acquired by residents of the United States and Canada by watching a promotional video launched from the Free Realms log-in screen between August 30 and September 26, 2011. It is no longer able to be acquired. This was a promotional tie in with Disney's release of "Tinkerbell and the Great Fairy Rescue."

Cannot Trade.

 Required 

Level 1, Any Job

Category:Flair Shard
Category:Unobtainable Flair

wiki_page.title: Pro Wizard Wand
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right

Pro Wizard Wand is a level 4 Wizard weapon. It is no longer able to be acquired. It was previously acquired by completion of the quest Wizard: Lost Student.

Cannot Trade.

 Required 

Level 4, Wizard

 Effects 

Zap: Zaps enemies with lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 488 damage.

Lightning Blast: Creates a huge blast of lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 1998 damage.

wiki_page.title: Prowling Rat Bokken
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Prowling Rat Bokken is a level 1 Ninja weapon. It was previously randomly acquired from Level 1-4 Royal Vault chests,vault bug on YouTube until retired on December 14, 2009. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 1, Ninja

 Effects 

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 444 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 1998 damage.

Pro Brawler Hammer is a level 4 Brawler weapon. It is no longer able to be acquired. It was previously acquired by completion of the quest Brawler: One Man's Junk....

Cannot trade.

 Required 

Level 4, Brawler

 Effects 

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 444 damage.
Sometimes knocks opponents down.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all enemies around you.
Deals 1554 damage.
Knocks opponents down.

wiki_page.text:
Pro Medic Saw is a level 8 Medic weapon. It is no longer able to be acquired. It was previously acquired by completion of the quest Medic: Dewpetal Tea.

Cannot Trade.

 Required 

Level 8, Medic

 Effects 

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 853 damage.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby enemies.
Heals 776 damage.
Deals 2716 damage.

wiki_page.title: Power Charmed Wand
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Power Charmed Wand is a level 1 Wizard weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Power Charmed Wand.

 Required 

Level 1, Wizard

 Effects 

Zap: Zaps enemies with lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 279 damage.

Lightning Blast: Creates a huge blast of lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 1143 damage.

Category:Lightning Blast

wiki_page.title: Prismatic Beam Saber
wiki_page.text:
Prismatic Beam Saber is the name of two different Ninja weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Prismatic Beam Saber
thumb|right|New School Prismatic Beam Saber
thumb|right|New School Prismatic Beam Saber

The New School version of Prismatic Beam Saber is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Prismatic Slash: Your prismatic beam of light slashes all opponents in front of you.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Kaleidoscope: A flash of prismatic light that damages all nearby opponents.
Deals 3x 506 damage at Level 1.
Deals 3x 885 damage at Level 4.
Deals 3x 1548 damage at Level 8.
Deals 3x 2707 damage at Level 12.
Deals 3x 4732 damage at Level 16.

Old School Prismatic Beam Saber
thumb|right|Old School Prismatic Beam Saber
thumb|right|Old School Prismatic Beam Saber

The Old School version of Prismatic Beam Saber was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3083 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 13876 damage.

wiki_page.title: Radioactive Beam Blade
wiki_page.text:
Radioactive Beam Blade is the name of two different Ninja weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Radioactive Beam Blade
thumb|right|New School Radioactive Beam Blade
thumb|right|New School Radioactive Beam Blade

The New School version of Radioactive Beam Blade is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Radiation Slash: Slash at opponents in front of you with a beam of radiation.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Radioactive Aura: An aura of radiation covers the area and damages all nearby opponents.
Deals 3x 506 damage at Level 1.
Deals 3x 885 damage at Level 4.
Deals 3x 1548 damage at Level 8.
Deals 3x 2707 damage at Level 12.
Deals 3x 4732 damage at Level 16.

Old School Radioactive Beam Blade
thumb|right|Old School Radioactive Beam Blade
thumb|right|Old School Radioactive Beam Blade

The Old School version of Radioactive Beam Blade was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3083 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 13876 damage.

Category:Ninja
Category:Level 1 Weapons
Category:Power 5 Weapons
Category:Retired Weapons
Category:New School Weapons
Category:Old School Weapons
Category:SC Marketplace

wiki_page.title: Rainbow Coil Cutter
wiki_page.text:
Rainbow Coil Cutter is the name of three different Ninja weapons. One is a level 1 New School weapon sold through the SC shop, the other is a level 1 Old School weapon previously sold through the SC Shop, and another is a level 16 Treasure Trader weapon.

New School Rainbow Coil Cutter
thumb|right|New School Rainbow Coil Cutter
thumb|right|New School Rainbow Coil Cutter

The New School version of Rainbow Coil Cutter is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Rainbow Slash: Damage opponents in front of you with this dizzying rainbow slash.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Rainbow Cutter: Damage opponents in front of you with a single perfect cut.
Deals 1143 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1998 damage at Level 4.
Deals 3492 damage at Level 8.
Deals 6107 damage at Level 12.
Deals 10674 damage at Level 16.

Old School Rainbow Coil Cutter
thumb|right|Old School Rainbow Coil Cutter
thumb|right|Old School Rainbow Coil Cutter

The Old School version of Rainbow Coil Cutter was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3083 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 13876 damage.

Treasure Trader Rainbow Coil Cutter

thumb|right|Treasure Trader Rainbow Coil Cutter

Deals 1548 damage.

The Robgoblin T-Shirt is a Freestyle Jobs, chest slot, clothing item that is acquired through trade or completion of the quest titled Shift Swap, hosted by Kendall in Seaside.

Trivia
The picture of a robgoblin face in the shirt is the one of the offical Free Realms mascot, Robbie.

wiki_page.title: Scoped Stalker Bow
wiki_page.text:
Scoped Stalker Bow is the name of two different Archer weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Scoped Stalker Bow
thumb|right|New School Scoped Stalker Bow
thumb|right|New School Scoped Stalker Bow

The New School version of Scoped Stalker Bow is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Archer

Effects

Precise Shot: A highly accurate attack that hits opponents in front of you.
Deals 279 damage at Level 1.
Deals 488 damage at Level 4.
Deals 853 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1492 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2609 damage at Level 16.

Sniper Shot: A perfect shot that is more likely to cause critical damage to enemies in front of you.
Deals 889 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1554 damage at Level 4.
Deals 2716 damage at Level 8.
Deals 4750 damage at Level 12.
Deals 8302 damage at Level 16.

Old School Scoped Stalker Bow
thumb|right|Old School Scoped Stalker Bow
thumb|right|Old School Scoped Stalker Bow

The Old School version of Scoped Stalker Bow was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Archer

Effects

Barrage: Launches several arrows at once, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3391 damage.

Volley: Rains arrows down around you striking nearby opponents multiple times.
Deals 6143 damage.

wiki_page.title: Rowdy Rumbler Hammer
wiki_page.text:
thumb|Rowdy Rumbler Hammer Held 
Rowdy Rumbler Hammer is a level 4 Brawler weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Rowdy Rumbler Hammer.

 Required 

Level 4, Brawler

 Effects 

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 444 damage.
Sometimes knocks opponents down.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all enemies around you.
Deals 1554 damage.
Knocks opponents down.

Category:Brawler

Category:Power 2 Weapons

Category:Green Text Weapons
Category:Particle Effect
Category:Leg Sweep

thumb|right
thumb|right
Ring Rumbler Hammer is a level 12 Brawler weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 12, Brawler

 Effects 

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 1357 damage.
Sometimes knocks opponents down.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all enemies around you.
Deals 4750 damage.
Knocks opponents down.

wiki_page.title: Shard Wand
wiki_page.text:
Shard Wand is the name of three different Wizard weapons. One is a level 1 New School weapon sold through the SC shop, the other is a level 1 Old School weapon previously sold through the SC Shop, and another is a level 16 Treasure Trader weapon.

New School Shard Wand
thumb|right|New School Shard Wand
thumb|right|New School Shard Wand

The New School version of Shard Wand is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Wizard

Effects

Magical Missile: Attack the darkness in all nearby opponents.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Chaotic Flux: Unleash a wave of chaotic energy on all nearby opponents.
Deals 977 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1709 damage at Level 4.
Deals 2987 damage at Level 8.
Deals 5225 damage at Level 12.
Deals 9132 damage at Level 16.

Old School Shard Wand
thumb|right|Old School Shard Wand
thumb|right|Old School Shard Wand

The Old School version of Shard Wand was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Wizard

Effects

Zap: Zaps enemies with lightning, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3391 damage.

Lightning Blast: Creates a huge blast of lightning, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 13876 damage.

Treasure Trader Shard Wand
thumb|right|Treasure Trader Shard Wand
thumb|right|Treasure Trader Shard Wand

The Treasure Trader version of Shard Wand was previously acquired from the Facebook application, Free Realms Treasure Trader. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

wiki_page.title: Savage Sting Bow
wiki_page.text:
Savage Sting Bow is a level 12 Archer weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Savage Sting Bow.

 Required 

Level 12, Archer

 Effects 

Barrage: Launches several arrows at once, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2609 damage.

Volley: Rains arrows down around you striking nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 4732 damage.
Category:Archer
Category:Level 12 Weapons
Category:Power 5 Weapons
Category:Blacksmith Recipe Weapons
Category:Green Text Weapons
Category:Particle Effect
Category:Volley
Category:Weapon
Category:Combat Weapon

thumb

A potion that restores some of your health over 3 seconds.

Small Health Potion is a level 1 potion usable by any job. It is acquired from the prize wheel of the dungeon Hewey's Escape.

Required
Level 1, Any Job.
Activatable Effects
Heals you for 11% health/second for 3 seconds.Instantly heals you for 2% health.

 Required 

Level 16, Warrior

 Effects 

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby enemies.
Deals 2609 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 4732 damage.

wiki_page.title: Skylightning Firecracker
wiki_page.text:
thumb

The Skylightning Firecracker is a consumable item usable by any job. It is acquired through redeeming the Trading Card Game Series 1 Virtual Reward loot card of the same name.

Loot Card

Skylightning Firecracker is a Virtual Reward loot card that is randomly acquired from opening Trading Card Game Series 1 booster packs. When redeemed, one Skylightning Firecracker is received through the redeeming player's communicator. The card's ID is 1L88.

Category:Virtual Rewards
Category:Consumable
Category:Trading Card Game

thumb|right
thumb|right
Solar Charmed Wand is a level 4 Wizard weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 4, Wizard

 Effects 

Zap: Zaps enemies with lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 488 damage.

Lightning Blast: Creates a huge blast of lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 1998 damage.

Deals 10674 damage.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right

Damages spiders on contact (as well as anything else you swing at).

Spider Bite is a level 16 Ninja weapon. It is acquired by entering the code from Free Realms comic book #1.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

 Required 

Level 16, Ninja

 Effects 

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2372 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 10674 damage.

wiki_page.title: Storm Breaker
wiki_page.text:
Storm Breaker is the name of three different Ninja weapons. One is a level 1 New School weapon sold through the SC shop, the other is a level 1 Old School weapon previously sold through the SC Shop, and another is a level 16 Treasure Trader weapon.

New School Storm Breaker
thumb|right|New School Storm Breaker
thumb|right|New School Storm Breaker

The New School version of Storm Breaker is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Tidal Slash: Slash at opponents in front of you with the fluid grace of the tides.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Thunderstorm: A surge of lightning damages all nearby opponents.
Deals 889 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1554 damage at Level 4.
Deals 2716 damage at Level 8.
Deals 4750 damage at Level 12.
Deals 8302 damage at Level 16.

Old School Storm Breaker
thumb|right|Old School Storm Breaker
thumb|right|Old School Storm Breaker

The Old School version of Storm Breaker was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Ninja

Effects

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3083 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all opponents in front of you.
Deals 13876 damage.

Treasure Trader Storm Breaker
thumb|right|Treasure Trader Storm Breaker
thumb|right|Treasure Trader Storm Breaker

The Treasure Trader version of Storm Breaker was previously acquired from the Facebook application, F

wiki_page.title: Striking Serpent Sword
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Striking Serpent Sword is a level 16 Ninja weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Striking Serpent Sword.

 Required 

Level 16, Ninja

 Effects 

Flame Flash: Strikes in a flash of stunning fire. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2372 damage.
Sometimes stuns opponents.

Dragonstrike: Strikes enemies with the force of a dragon. Damages all enemies in front of you.
Deals 10674 damage.
Category:Ninja
Category:Level 16 Weapons
Category:Power 5 Weapons
Category:Green Text Weapons
Category:Blacksmith Recipe Weapons
Category:Particle Effect
Category:Dragonstrike
Category:Weapon
Category:Combat Weapon

wiki_page.title: Strong Scrapper Hammer
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Strong Scrapper Hammer is a level 12 Brawler weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Strong Scrapper Hammer.

 Required 

Level 12, Brawler

 Effects 

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2372 damage.
Sometimes knocks opponents down.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all enemies around you.
Deals 8302 damage.
Knocks opponents down.

Steadfast Guardian Hammer is a level 16 Warrior weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 16, Warrior

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby enemies.
Deals 2609 damage.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 4732 damage.

wiki_page.title: Split Saw
wiki_page.text:
Split Saw is the name of two different Medic weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Split Saw
thumb|right|New School Split Saw
thumb|right|New School Split Saw

The New School version of Split Saw is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Medic

Effects

Precise Strikes: Strike opponents in front of you with 2 precise attacks that are more likely to do critical damage.
Deals 2x 127 damage at Level 1.
Deals 2x 222 damage at Level 4.
Deals 2x 388 damage at Level 8.
Deals 2x 678 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2x 1186 damage at Level 16.

Vital Strike: Deliver a targeted attack to opponents in front of you. Is more likely to inflict critical damage.
Deals 1143 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1998 damage at Level 4.
Deals 3492 damage at Level 8.
Deals 6107 damage at Level 12.
Deals 10674 damage at Level 16.

Old School Split Saw
thumb|right|Old School Split Saw
thumb|right|Old School Split Saw

The Old School version of Split Saw was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Medic

Effects

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3391 damage.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby opponents.
Heals 3083 damage.
Deals 10792 damage.

wiki_page.title: Torque Trasher
wiki_page.text:
Torque Trasher is the name of two different Brawler weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Torque Trasher
thumb|right|New School Torque Trasher
thumb|right|New School Torque Trasher

The New School version of Torque Trasher is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Brawler

Effects

Turbo Smash: Deliver a turbo-charged smash to opponents in front of you.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Overdrive: Delivers maximum damage to all nearby opponents.
Deals 889 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1554 damage at Level 4.
Deals 2716 damage at Level 8.
Deals 4750 damage at Level 12.
Deals 8302 damage at Level 16.

Old School Torque Trasher
thumb|right|Old School Torque Trasher
thumb|right|Old School Torque Trasher

The Old School version of Torque Trasher was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Brawler

Effects

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3083 damage.
Sometimes knocks opponents down.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all opponents around you.
Deals 10792 damage.
Knocks opponents down.

The Rumbler is a level 20 Brawler weapon. It is acquired by completion of the quest Brawler: Paying Your Dues.

Cannot Trade.

 Required 

Level 20, Brawler

 Effects 

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2372 damage.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all enemies around you.
Deals 8302 damage.
Knocks opponents down.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Trauma Support Shockrod is a level 16 Medic weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Trauma Support Shockrod.

 Required 

Level 16, Medic

 Effects 

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 2609 damage.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby opponents.
Heals 2372 damage.
Deals 8302 damage.

wiki_page.title: Valiant Guardian Cudgel
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Valiant Guardian Cudgel is a level 1 Warrior weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Valiant Guardian Cudgel.

 Required 

Level 1, Warrior

 Effects 

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby enemies.
Deals 279 damage.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 506 damage.

Void Woven Wand is a level 16 Wizard weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Void Woven Wand.

Level 16, Wizard

 Effects 

Zap: Zaps enemies with lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2609 damage.

Lightning Blast: Creates a huge blast of lightning, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 10674 damage.

wiki_page.title: Wizard's Wand of Firestorm
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Wizard's Wand of Firestorm is a level 4 Wizard weapon. It is acquired from the Coin Shop where it sells for  and it is also acquired from the prize wheels at Arachnia's Lair, Highroad Hijinx, Petty Yetis!, Robgoblin Adept Trouble!, and Robgoblin Creek.

 Required 

Level 4, Wizard

 Effects 

Burn: Blasts enemies with magical fire, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 444 damage.
Sometimes deals additional damage.

Firestorm: Creates a wall of fire around you, continually damaging all nearby opponents.
Deals 885 damage.

wiki_page.title: Wilds Condo
wiki_page.text:
thumb|256px
The Wilds Condo is a housing lot that was awarded to every new player, as of January 26, 2012. Players that were created before this date and already had an Apartment were given the Wilds Condo as well.

Category:Lots
Category:Housing

article_facts: fact:housing: The Wilds Condo is the new starter home for new players entering the game, and existing players were also given a Wilds Condo of their own. | The Wilds Condo is the new starter home for new players just coming into the game. wiki_page.text:
Ziggy is an unobtainable triceratops pet that was formerly sold through the SC Marketplace at the price of  from December 17, 2009 to January 17, 2010.SOE Kicks Off Virtual Fundraiser for Child's Play on ZAM News

Ziggy was introduced as a benefit item for the Child's Play charitable organization. For every pet purchased, Sony Online Entertainment donated $10 to the charity, up to a total of $50,000.

Tricks

Ziggy can perform the following tricks:
 Chase Tail
 Hand Stand
 Charge

wiki_page.title: Twin Crescent Axe
wiki_page.text:
Twin Crescent Axe is the name of two different Warrior weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Twin Crescent Axe
thumb|right|New School Twin Crescent Axe
thumb|right|New School Twin Crescent Axe

The New School version of Twin Crescent Axe is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Warrior

Effects

Ember Strike: Attack all opponents in front of you with burning fury!
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Ignite: Unleash the full power of your axe to burn all nearby opponents.
Deals 3x 506 damage at Level 1.
Deals 3x 885 damage at Level 4.
Deals 3x 1548 damage at Level 8.
Deals 3x 2707 damage at Level 12.
Deals 3x 4732 damage at Level 16.

Old School Twin Crescent Axe
thumb|right|Old School Twin Crescent Axe
thumb|right|Old School Twin Crescent Axe

The Old School version of Twin Crescent Axe was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Warrior

Effects

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby opponents.
Deals 3391 damage.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby opponents multiple times.
Deals 6143 damage.

wiki_page.title: Callahan's Cutter
wiki_page.text:
alt=|thumb
thumb|right

Callahan's Cutter is a level 20 Medic weapon. It is acquired by completion of the quest Medic: Paying Your Student Debts.

Cannot Trade.

 Required 

Level 20, Medic

 Effects 

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2609 damage.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby enemies.
Heals 2372 damage.
Deals 8302 damage.

wiki_page.title: Battle Item Mystery Pack
wiki_page.text:
thumb

Battle Item Mystery Pack is a prize granted by most combat mini-game prize wheels in Free Realms. It is not an item itself, but when a prize wheel lands on Battle Item Mystery Pack you receive instead three identical battle items chosen at random. There is likely a correlation between items granted by a Battle Item Mystery Pack and the difficulty of the combat mini-game where they are rewarded but that correlation, if any, hasn’t been determined.

 Prizes 

Battle Item Mystery Packs provide one of the following prizes:

Three Blast Orbs
Three Blast Spheres
Three Confusion Orbs
Three Confusion Spheres
Three Flabbergast Orbs
Three Flabbergast Spheres
Three Frag Orbs
Three Frag Spheres
Three Medium Energy Potions
Three Medium Health Potions
Three Medium Replenishment Potions
Three Sleep Orbs
Three Sleep Spheres
Three Unmoving Orbs
Three Unmoving Spheres

Category:Combat Mini-game
Category:BrawlWiki

wiki_page.title: Forked Wand
wiki_page.text:
Forked Wand is the name of two different Wizard weapons. One is a New School weapon sold through the SC shop. The other is an Old School weapon previously sold through the SC shop.

New School Forked Wand
thumb|right|New School Forked Wand
thumb|right|New School Forked Wand

The New School version of Forked Wand is acquired from the Station Cash Marketplace, where it sells at the regular price of , and to Members at the 10% discount price of .

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Wizard

Effects

Pulse: Launch a pulse of energy at all nearby opponents.
Deals 254 damage at Level 1.
Deals 444 damage at Level 4.
Deals 776 damage at Level 8.
Deals 1357 damage at Level 12.
Deals 2372 damage at Level 16.

Purge: Purge the area of nearby opponents with your awesome power.
Deals 889 damage at Level 1.
Deals 1554 damage at Level 4.
Deals 2716 damage at Level 8.
Deals 4750 damage at Level 12.
Deals 8302 damage at Level 16.

Old School Forked Wand
thumb|right|Old School Forked Wand
thumb|right|Old School Forked Wand

The Old School version of Forked Wand was previously sold through the Station Cash Marketplace. It can no longer be acquired.

Cannot Sell. Cannot Trade.

Required

Level 1, Wizard

Effects

Zap: Zaps enemies with lightning, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 3391 damage.

Lightning Blast: Creates a huge blast of lightning, damaging all opponents in front of you.
Deals 13876 damage.

wiki_page.title: Intrepid Protector Axe
wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Intrepid Protector Axe is a level 16 Warrior weapon. It is a Green Text weapon, but it can still acquired from the Blacksmith recipe Intrepid Protector Axe.

 Required 

Level 16, Warrior

 Effects 

Sweeping Slash: Slashes with wild swings, damaging all nearby enemies.
Deals 2609 damage.

Spinning Attack: Spins around with weapons extended slicing anything in range. Damages all nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 4372 damage.
Category:Warrior
Category:Level 16 Weapons
Category:Power 5 Weapons
Category:Blacksmith Recipe Weapons
Category:Green Text Weapons
Category:Particle Effect
Category:Spinning Attack
Category:Weapon
Category:Combat Weapon

wiki_page.title: Trick Shot Bow
wiki_page.text:
Trick Shot Bow is a level 16 Archer weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 16, Archer

 Effects 

Barrage: Launches several arrows at once, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 2609 damage.

Volley: Rains arrows down around you striking nearby enemies multiple times.
Deals 4732 damage.
Category:Archer
Category:Level 16 Weapons
Category:Power 5 Weapons
Category:Green Text Weapons
Category:Retired Weapons
Category:Particle Effect
Category:Volley
Category:Weapon
Category:Combat Weapon

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all enemies in front of you.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby enemies.
Heals 2372 damage.
Deals 8302 damage.

wiki_page.text:
thumb|right
thumb|right
Street Scrapper Hammer is a level 4 Brawler weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 4, Brawler

 Effects 

Glancing Blow: Delivers a quick strike, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 776 damage.
Sometimes knocks opponents down.

Leg Sweep: Performs a powerful sweeping kick, damaging all enemies around you.
Deals 2716 damage.
Knocks opponents down.

wiki_page.title: Rumbledome Lot
wiki_page.text:
thumb|256px

The Rumbledome Lot is a housing lot that is acquired through redeeming the Trading Card Game Series 5 Virtual Reward loot card of the same name. It resembles the appearance of Rumbledome in Sunstone Valley.First Look: TCG Set 5 Rumbledome! Loot on Free Realms

Loot Card

Rumbledome Lot is a Virtual Reward loot card that is randomly acquired from opening Trading Card Game Series 5 booster packs. When redeemed, one Rumbledome Lot is received through the redeeming player's communicator. The card's ID is 5L3.

Heal Support Bonesaw is a level 1 Medic weapon. It is a Green Text weapon and can only be acquired through trade.

 Required 

Level 12, Medic

Incision: Strikes with surgical precision, damaging all enemies in front of you.
Deals 1492 damage.

Triage: Sorts out friend from foe with surgical precision, healing you and your group and damaging all nearby enemies.
Heals 1357 damage.
Deals 4750 damage.

wiki_page.text:
Were you look for the pet pal?

The Snowman is an enemy NPC that appears throughout Snowhill.

Battle
Snowmen can be found in Snowhill. They are feature at the Snow Days when they arrives to stealing the presents.

Appearances
Ambushed!
Crafty Robgoblins
Trading Card Game Series 3
